This is the right point to hand off. The audit is substantial enough that it should be completed in one dedicated conversation without mixing it with implementation work.
KoreLumina Handoff — RA-001 Repository Architecture AuditMissionBegin RA-001 — Repository Architecture Audit.This is the final audit before resuming KoreLumina product implementation.The objective is not to implement new features.The objective is to establish a verified baseline of the entire repository so the remainder of KoreLumina can be executed from a single authoritative roadmap.No roadmap shall be drafted until this audit is complete.Critical ContextKoreLumina has completed a substantial portion of the Engineering Intelligence Platform (KP).However, KP was never intended to replace the KoreLumina product roadmap.KP exists because the founder wanted the personal KoreLumina Engineer Agent to learn while KoreLumina is being built.The relationship is:Product Implementation↓Engineer observes↓Engineer learns↓Engineer improves↓Better implementation↓Better EngineerTherefore:KP is not the implementation roadmap.KP is the Engineer Growth curriculum accompanying the implementation roadmap.Core PrincipleThe Landing Page is the customer contract.The Original Roadmap defines implementation intent.The Architecture defines engineering dependency.KP defines Engineer Growth.The Master Execution Roadmap will synchronize all four.Production Engineering RulesThese rules are mandatory.Repository FirstNever rely on conversation memory.Repository evidence is authoritative.If repository
